# The Perfect Lie

**Do language models write a lie to fit what a particular judge finds convincing?** Why Would I Lie (WWIL), three
pre-registered phases: Phase 1 finds the effect, Phase 2 asks why the liar follows one path rather than another
(belief-tracking or priming), Phase 3 probes causality (activation probe and steering). With every lie, grade and
verdict, the analyses, a write-up and a push-button reproduction.

study lives entirely under [`two_truths_lie_study/`](https://github.com/RandallSPQR/edsl_wwil/tree/main/two_truths_lie_study).
